title: Outcome, economic and operational benefits of hybrid courses - A public research university perspective
reason: Course-level comparison of final exam averages across 2011-2013 cohorts as online content was added, plus course ratings and staff-time costs; no per-student platform measure (forums, quizzes, video use) is related to outcomes.

extraction.design: case study, cohort comparison across years
extraction.population: mechanical and aerospace engineering undergraduates, UC Irvine (3 courses, 50-350 students each)
extraction.outcome_or_construct: final exam average per cohort; course evaluations; instructor/TA time
extraction.notes: Dynamics cohorts of 314, 352 and later years; average grade 60.9/61.0, 64.1, 66.1. ASEE 2013 conference paper.
